tldr: 台股上週五大漲693點重返46,500，聯準會升息疑慮降溫點火，但外資仍連2賣提款481億。
台積電全球同步興建近20座廠，AI設備需求飆至1.9倍，營造人力短缺成擴產最大瓶頸。
久未往來帳戶新制9/1上路，金管會8項新制推動壽險業接軌IFRS 17/ICS大轉型。

items.title_zh: 台股大漲693點重返46,500 聯準會升息疑慮降溫點火
items.title_en: TAIEX surges 693 points to reclaim 46,500 as Fed rate-hike fears ease
items.summary_zh: 台股上週五（9/4）收在46,551.13點，大漲693.47點（1.51%），重返5日線、周漲219點連二紅。台積電漲20元至2,410元，鴻海漲3.43%、台達電漲3.69%、聯發科漲1.72%同步走高。美國升息疑慮降溫、美債殖利率回落，帶動權值股全面反彈，短線多頭氣勢重新回穩。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index closed Friday (Sept 4) at 46,551.13, up 693.47 points or 1.51%, retaking its 5-day average and logging a second straight weekly gain of 219 points. TSMC rose NT$20 to NT$2,410, with Hon Hai (+3.43%), Delta (+3.69%) and MediaTek (+1.72%) all advancing. Cooling U.S. rate-hike expectations and softer Treasury yields reignited bullish sentiment across heavyweight tech names.

items.title_zh: 外資連2賣提款481億 減碼記憶體與ETF
items.title_en: Foreign investors extend selling, trimming memory names and ETFs
items.summary_zh: 外資賣超台股481億元、連續第2個交易日站在賣方，並減碼記憶體類股與ETF部位。外資持續調節顯示對評價面與全球利率不確定性仍偏審慎；不過在聯準會升息疑慮降溫與內資承接下，大盤稍後仍收復失土，反映籌碼面雖有壓力、但買盤信心逐步回穩。
items.summary_en: Overseas institutional investors sold a net NT$48.1 billion of Taiwan shares, marking a second consecutive session of net selling as they pared holdings in memory-chip stocks and ETFs ahead of Friday's rebound. The persistent foreign outflow underscores lingering caution over valuations and global rate uncertainty, even as domestic buyers and improving Fed sentiment later helped the broader index recover ground.

items.title_zh: 台積電全球同步興建近20座廠 AI設備需求飆至1.9倍
items.title_en: TSMC building nearly 20 fabs worldwide as AI equipment demand jumps to 1.9x
items.summary_zh: 台積電資深副總侯永清於SEMICON Taiwan 2026指出，2026年設備採購需求自去年底的1倍基準，一季內上修至1.5倍、七月更達1.9倍，反映AI需求爆發。台積電在台興建13座廠、海外5至6座，全球近20座同步動工。他坦言生態系尚未準備好，台灣與美國亞利桑那均面臨營造人力短缺，成為擴產一大瓶頸。
items.summary_en: At SEMICON Taiwan 2026, TSMC senior VP Y.P. Chyan said projected 2026 equipment demand has climbed from a 1x baseline late last year to 1.5x within a quarter and 1.9x by July, driven by relentless AI orders. TSMC is building 13 fabs in Taiwan plus 5-6 abroad — nearly 20 simultaneously. He warned the ecosystem is not ready, with construction-labor shortages now a key bottleneck across Taiwan and Arizona.

items.title_zh: 轉單傳言對台積電僅「小打小鬧」 AI定價權穩固
items.title_en: Order-transfer rumors seen as minor noise for TSMC amid AI pricing power
items.summary_zh: 產業分析認為，市場關於轉單離開台積電的傳言，在其AI時代定價權與先進製程、封裝優勢下，影響僅屬「小打小鬧」。隨AI題材由GPU擴散至整櫃伺服器、液冷散熱、PCB/CCL、電源供應、HBM/CoWoS與CPO矽光子等領域，台積電對尖端產能的掌握力，使其在算力供應鏈中維持關鍵地位，短期雜音難撼動基本盤。
items.summary_en: Industry analysis argues that talk of order shifts away from TSMC amounts to "small stuff" given the foundry's dominant position in AI-era pricing power, from process leadership to advanced packaging. As the AI theme broadens beyond GPUs to rack-scale servers, liquid cooling, PCB/CCL, power delivery, HBM/CoWoS and CPO/silicon photonics, TSMC's leverage over leading-edge capacity keeps it central to the compute supply chain despite competitive noise.

items.title_zh: 久未往來帳戶新制9/1上路 提款轉帳額度大縮水
items.title_en: Dormant-account curbs take effect Sept 1, capping daily withdrawals and transfers
items.summary_zh: 自9月1日起，銀行對長期無交易、低餘額的「久未往來帳戶」祭出交易限制，大幅調降每日提款與轉帳上限。此舉旨在降低閒置帳戶淪為詐騙與洗錢工具的風險，但部分民眾未留意、發現戶頭有錢卻領不出。客戶須臨櫃辦理恢復帳戶功能，全國多家銀行同步實施，短期增添零售金融的作業與法遵摩擦。
items.summary_en: From September 1, banks began imposing transaction limits on long-inactive, low-balance "dormant" accounts, sharply cutting daily ATM withdrawal and transfer ceilings. The measure is aimed at reducing the misuse of idle accounts in fraud and money-laundering, but caught some holders off guard who found funds harder to access. Customers must reactivate accounts at branches to restore full functionality, adding compliance friction across the retail-banking system.

items.title_zh: 金管會公布明年8項新制 壽險業迎IFRS 17/ICS大轉型
items.title_en: FSC unveils 8 new rules for 2026 as life insurers brace for IFRS 17/ICS shift
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布2026年將上路的8項新制，保險局2項聚焦壽險業接軌IFRS 17保險合約會計與新一代清償能力制度（ICS）。以公允價值衡量保險負債將對業者財報結構產生深遠影響，促使強化資產負債管理（ALM），並由長期保證型商品轉向保障型商品。證期局另有股東會議事手冊揭露時程提前、電子紀念品平台預計3月底上線等新制。
items.summary_en: The FSC announced eight new measures taking effect in early 2026, with insurance-bureau items centered on adopting IFRS 17 and the new-generation solvency regime (ICS). Fair-value liability measurement will structurally reshape insurers' balance sheets, pushing firms to strengthen asset-liability management and pivot from long-term guaranteed products toward protection-oriented offerings. Securities-bureau rules also advance shareholder-meeting disclosure timelines and an e-gift platform launching by end-March.

items.title_zh: 中信X BCG報告：十億超高資產客群86%持有境外資產
items.title_en: CTBC-BCG report: 86% of Taiwan's billion-dollar UHNW hold offshore assets
items.summary_zh: 中國信託攜手BCG發布台灣超高資產客群洞察，指出十億等級超高資產家庭約86%已持有境外資產，逾半數海外配置比重達20%以上。該客群財富預估2025至2029年複合成長率達11%，明顯高於全體個人財富6%的增速。數據反映台灣頂端家族對跨境信託、私人銀行與結構型商品等傳承與資產配置服務的需求持續升溫。
items.summary_en: A CTBC x BCG study on Taiwan's ultra-high-net-worth segment finds about 86% of billion-NT-dollar households already hold offshore assets, with more than half allocating at least 20% overseas. The cohort's wealth is projected to grow at an 11% CAGR through 2025-2029, well above the 6% pace for overall personal wealth on the island. The findings signal rising demand for cross-border trust, private banking and structured-product solutions among Taiwan's wealthiest families.

items.title_zh: 10家壽險獲金管會核准辦理財富管理業務
items.title_en: Ten life insurers cleared to run wealth-management business
items.summary_zh: 截至2026年5月，新光、南山、富邦、國泰、凱基、台灣、保誠、安達、法國巴黎及元大等10家壽險公司已獲金管會核准辦理財富管理業務，為高資產客戶在銀行之外開拓更多服務通路。配合政府亞洲資產管理中心政策推動，信託、基金、保險與結構型商品競爭加劇，讓高資產族群在跨資產配置上獲得更多一站式規劃選擇。
items.summary_en: As of May 2026, ten life insurers — including Shin Kong, Nan Shan, Fubon, Cathay, KGI, Taiwan Life, Chubb, BNP Paribas Cardif and Yuanta — have received FSC approval to conduct wealth-management operations, widening the channels available to high-asset clients beyond banks. The build-out, alongside the government's asset-management-center push, deepens competition in trusts, funds, insurance and structured products, giving affluent savers more one-stop options for cross-asset planning.
